reference.interior_sampling: local x,z in {2,6,10,14} on each 16x16 chunk
limitations: Profiles are per-voxel references at a deterministic 4x4 lattice, not a connected cave/ravine instance census.
Columns touched by player/mod edits are not independently identified; classify surface material as natural-appearing only.
Missing section data is unknown, never inferred as air.
Already generated save chunks reflect player exploration bias.
reference.surface_sampling: all 256 columns per sampled chunk; highest natural substrate
